description: Detects writing style violations and AI tropes. The Bash path (worktree-snapshot.ts, then lint.ts on PostToolUse Bash) retires if under 5% of its run-log rows inject over 4 weeks, and its detection is revisited if writing-bash-coverage misses stay above 30%

hooks.command: IFS= read -r in; case $in in *--body*|*--message*|*--description*|*--title*|*=@*|*-F*|*--file*|*--input*|*-m*|*-?m*|*-b*|*\<*) if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE -- '--(body|message|description|title)[-= ]|(-F|--field)[= ][^ ]*=@|git (commit|tag).* (-F|--file)[= ]|git (commit|tag).* -[a-zA-Z]*m |--input[= ]|(review|note|discussion)[^|;&]*( <|-m |-b )'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lint.ts"; fi ;; esac
IFS= read -r in; if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE '([ `]|\\t).*([ `]|\\t).*([ `]|\\t)'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lint.ts"; fi
